how_to_fill: Policy graph for tau2-bench telecom, same schema as airline_policy_graph.json. Each condition: condition, actor (agent or user), check (data = the agent can check it in tool results; dialogue = only visible in the conversation; device = only visible on the user's phone), source (bullet id), if_fails (default deny, G3). any_of / all_of = OR / AND. 'order' in needs_info = must be asked in that order. 'must_happen_before' = this step must be done before the named action. New for telecom: 'procedures' = troubleshooting steps the agent must guide the USER to do on their own phone (diagnose with a user read tool, then fix with a user write tool), with 'prerequisite' and 'then' for order.
status: First draft written with AI help from main_policy.md and tech_support_manual.md (tau2-bench commit da0835f). Checked by hand on 2026-11-09: all 57 entries compared with the two files (see telecom_graph_check.xlsx), all marked verified. Notes: make_payment is a user tool in tau2 although the policy text says 'use the make_payment tool' (P5); the 'transfer' fallback of S3 comes from tech_support_manual.md (Line Suspension); tau2 has no agent tool to change a plan (CP1), so that rule is never used.
rule_of_thumb: Graph = same content as main_policy.md + tech_support_manual.md, only the form differs. Nothing added, nothing dropped.
source_ids: Main policy: G1-G6 global, L1 customer lookup, P1-P7 overdue bill payment, S1-S4 line suspension, F1-F4 data refueling, CP1 change plan, RO1 data roaming. Tech support manual: T0 identify customer + try all ways before transfer, SV1-SV4 cellular service, MD1-MD7 mobile data, MM1-MM5 MMS. Numbered top to bottom in each file.

info_only.text: customer profile fields: customer ID, full name, date of birth, email, phone number, address, account status, created date, payment methods, line IDs, bill IDs, last extension date, goodwill credit usage
account status: Active, Suspended, Pending Verification, Closed; line status: Active, Suspended, Pending Activation, Closed; bill status: Draft, Issued, Paid, Overdue, Awaiting Payment, Disputed

global_rules.condition: give no information, knowledge or procedures not given by the user or available tools; no subjective recommendations or comments
make one tool call at a time; never call a tool and reply to the user in the same turn
deny user requests that are against this policy
transfer to a human agent if and only if the request cannot be handled within the scope of the agent's actions
to transfer: first call transfer_to_human_agents, then send the message 'YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.'
try your best (all possible ways) to resolve the issue before transferring to a human agent
look up the customer by phone number, customer ID, or full name with date of birth (date of birth is required for a name lookup)
for technical support, first identify the customer

needs_info.info: customer (identified by phone number, customer ID, or full name + date of birth)

conditions.condition: the bill status is Overdue (check the bill before sending)
the agent has checked the bill amount due
the customer has no other bill in AWAITING PAYMENT status (only one at a time)

facts.text: sending the request changes the bill status to AWAITING PAYMENT
the send payment request tool does not check if the bill is overdue; the agent must check it before the call

after.text: tell the user a payment request was sent and that they should check it with check_payment_request (user tool)
if the user accepts, the payment is made with make_payment (user tool); the bill then becomes PAID
check that the bill status is PAID before telling the user the bill is paid

needs_info.info: customer and the line (phone number) the user means

conditions.condition: the user has paid all their overdue bills
the line's contract end date is not in the past (even if all bills are paid)

facts.text: a line can be suspended because the user has an overdue bill or because the line's contract end date is in the past; a suspended line has no service
if the suspension cannot be lifted by the agent, escalate to technical support

after.text: after the line is resumed, the user must reboot the device (reboot_device) to get service; then verify service is restored

needs_info.info: how much data the user wants to refuel
the line of the phone number the user provided

conditions.condition: the agent confirmed the price (plan's refueling price per GB) with the user before the call
the data is applied to the line associated with the phone number the user provided

facts.text: if data usage exceeds the plan's data limit, data connectivity is lost; the user can change to a plan with more data or refuel data

actions.tool: (no agent tool for this in the telecom tool list)

needs_info.info: which line the user wants to change the plan for
the plan the user selects from the available plans

conditions.condition: the agent gathered the available plans, calculated the price of the new plan and confirmed the price with the user before applying it

needs_info.info: the line of the phone number the user provided

conditions.condition: the user is traveling outside their home network (abroad)
the line is not roaming enabled yet

facts.text: roaming is enabled at no cost for the user
the user must also turn Data Roaming ON on the phone (toggle_roaming)

conditions.condition: the request cannot be handled within the scope of the agent's actions, after trying all possible ways

facts.text: escalate (transfer) when the SIM is Locked (PIN/PUK), or when a suspension cannot be lifted by the agent

procedures.diagnose: check_status_bar (no signal strength shown = no service)

steps.if: airplane mode is ON (check_status_bar or check_network_status)
steps.fix: guide the user to toggle_airplane_mode to turn it OFF
follow resume_line rules; if allowed, resume and verify service; if not, escalate

procedures.issue: mobile data not working or slow
procedures.diagnose: run_speed_test ('no connection' = no data; any speed below Excellent = slow)

steps.fix: guide the user to toggle_airplane_mode to turn it OFF
guide the user to toggle_data to turn it ON

steps.if: the user is abroad and Data Roaming is OFF on the phone
steps.fix: guide the user to toggle_roaming to turn it ON

steps.if: the user is abroad and the line is not roaming enabled
check_data_restriction_status shows Data Saver mode is ON
steps.fix: guide the user to toggle_data_saver_mode to turn it OFF

steps.if: check_vpn_status shows VPN ON and connected with performance Poor
data usage of the line exceeds the plan's data limit
steps.fix: offer a plan with more data or refuel data (refuel_data rules)
guide the user to set_network_mode_preference with mode '4g_5g_preferred'

procedures.prerequisite: cellular service and mobile data (any speed) must work first

steps.fix: guide the user to set_network_mode_preference to a mode with 3G/4G/5G (e.g. '4g_5g_preferred' or '4g_only')

steps.if: check_apn_settings shows the MMSC URL is not set
check_wifi_calling_status shows Wi-Fi Calling is ON
steps.fix: guide the user to toggle_wifi_calling to turn it OFF

steps.if: check_app_permissions(app_name='messaging') does not list 'storage' and 'sms' as granted
steps.fix: guide the user to grant_app_permission(app_name='messaging', permission='storage') and (permission='sms')
